correctness.rationale: For distinct planar unit support normals in increasing circular order, each retained directed adjacent pair when angular gap <π is equivalent to d_i=u_i J a_i+v_i J a_{i+1} with u_i,v_i≥0. In the all-small-gap case, the closed polygonal chain projected on any a_i is first nonincreasing then nondecreasing across the antipodal cut, making all nonadjacent support constraints jointly redundant. For a unique gap ≥π, remove its two constraints and use the monotone open chain along the remaining semicircle. Each retained constraint has a one-target-active witness using perturbed tangent polygons (auxiliary normals across a large gap), with x_i=a_i a strict interior configuration and exact common-translation lineality. Thus facets are 2N or 2(N-1), for N≥3 including a gap precisely π. Independent scipy LP primal separation checked 50 target inequalities across four small/large/exact-semicircle normal configurations, not an all-N proof.
